uutiset.t: Congo Gold Trader Plans Two Refineries with 68-Ton Capacity
uutiset.s: Democratic Republic of Congo’s state gold trader plans to build two refineries with capacity for 68 tons as the country looks to curb smuggling and profit more from its reserves of the precious metal.

uutiset.t: What JLL Sees This Holiday Season
uutiset.s: JLL’s 2026 Holiday Retail Report found holiday spending is up 9.7% from last year, with more consumers directing more of their budgets toward experiences. uutiset.t: BCG on What’s Keeping CEOs Up at Night
uutiset.s: From AI and employee trust to political uncertainty and pressure for growth, a new Boston Consulting Group survey reveals what’s weighing on business leaders. Matthias Tauber, Managing Partner for EMEA at BCG, discussed what’s keeping CEOs up at night with Stephen Carroll on Bloomberg Markets. (Sour

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso Sees Worst Losing Streak Since 2021 on Carry Unwind
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso is headed for its longest losing streak in five years as investors flee to safe haven assets and the popular carry trade unravels.

uutiset.t: Latvia Backs Air Baltic Guarantee as it Searches for Investor
uutiset.s: Latvia’s parliament backed a €175 million ($192 million) guarantee for state-owned Air Baltic Corp. to unlock the next stage of financing in its Chapter 11 restructuring as the troubled airline risks running out of money next month.

uutiset.t: (USD:ZAR) Rand Hurtles Toward Worst November Against Dollar in 25 Years
uutiset.s: South Africa’s rand is being buffeted by domestic and global headwinds that have put the currency on course for the worst November against the dollar in 25 years.

uutiset.t: Oil Refining Profits Crash With Global Fuel Supply Rebounding
uutiset.s: The amount of money oil refiners are making from turning crude into fuel has slumped to the lowest in months as recovering supply and sluggish demand ease the impact of the Iran war.

uutiset.t: ¿Qué causó las fallas tecnológicas en EE.UU.?
uutiset.s: Microsoft, aerolíneas, la NSA, JPMorgan y Apple sufrieron fallas en pocos días. No hay evidencia de que estén conectadas, pero sí una alerta: la IA descubre errores mucho más rápido de lo que pueden corregirse. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Spain's De Cos Set to Succeed Lagarde as ECB President
uutiset.s: Pablo Hernandez de Cos is set to become European Central Bank president, directing the region’s fight against inflation and possible bond turmoil. uutiset.t: Energy Trader BGN Targets Agriculture in Latest Expansion Push
uutiset.s: Commodities trading firm BGN is moving into agriculture, adding to a rapid global expansion beyond the core energy markets.

uutiset.t: UK Is Latest Big European Economy to Report Diesel Demand Slump
uutiset.s: The UK is the latest major European country to report faltering sales of diesel fuel amid sky-high prices triggered by conflicts in the Middle East and Ukraine.

uutiset.t: Nigeria Boosts Retail Supply of Dollars to Curb Naira Volatility
uutiset.s: The Central Bank of Nigeria approved a large increase in the sale of dollars to retail customers as it sought to boost local liquidity and ease pressure on the naira, which has lost ground this month.

uutiset.t: Altria, Japan Tobacco Explore Takeover of Imperial Brands
uutiset.s: Altria Group Inc. and Japan Tobacco Inc. are exploring a potential takeover of British cigarette maker Imperial Brands Plc, accelerating consolidation in the declining cigarette market in what would be one of the biggest UK acquisitions in a decade.

uutiset.t: UBS Vows to Remain Global as Swiss Capital Outlook Darkens
uutiset.s: UBS Group AG’s top leadership sought to reassure staff that Switzerland’s effort to tighten regulation won’t take away something the bank has been building for decades — a truly global business.

uutiset.t: Brazil Tightens Consumer Lending Rules as Family Debt Soars
uutiset.s: Brazil’s central bank unveiled measures to curb excessive consumer borrowing as President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva grows concerned about soaring household debt.
